environment.description: Tomcat 9.0.68 on Amazon Linux 2, fronted by an ALB with an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL includes a single managed rule group: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with all rules in default action (BLOCK for matching). Additionally, a custom rule with priority 0 uses a RegexPatternSet that matches request query strings against the pattern '(?i)(union|select|insert|update|delete|drop|;|--|/\*|\*/|xp_|0x[0-9a-f]{4,}|benchmark|sleep|extractvalue|updatexml)' with action BLOCK. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm both rules are actively evaluating. The ALB forwards to Tomcat on port 8080 in a private subnet.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAFv2 WebACL attached
config.database: PostgreSQL 14.6 RDS, user reports_app with schema-level grants
